name: Galleons of Fortune: Pioneers
detailed_description:
Galleons of Fortune is a trade management and simulation game set in 16th-century Seville during the golden age of the Spanish Armada and the Treasure Fleet. In this fascinating game, you take on the role of a visionary and bold merchant in charge of a thriving business that connects the Old World to the riches of the New World.

Manage your own commercial empire from the bustling port of Seville, where you will make key decisions on which goods to import and export, negotiate with traders from around the world, and manage your ships and resources. As your wealth grows, so do the challenges: pirates, commercial rivalries, market fluctuations, and the ever-present threat of competition.

Face the intriguing and dangerous journey of the Spanish Treasure Fleet, where each voyage is an opportunity to gain fortune, but also a risk of losing everything in search of riches from across the Atlantic. Will you become a shrewd merchant capable of growing your empire, or will you succumb to the unpredictable risks of the market?

Features:

  • Realistic trade simulation: Manage trade routes, calculate risks, and seek opportunities in a dynamic market.

  • Intellectual challenges: Earn a reputation among the port’s people through challenging games of Ajedreina and more.

  • Expand your empire: Grow your fleet of ships, establish trade routes, acquire precious goods from the New World, and dominate transatlantic trade.

  • Immerse yourself in history: Experience trade in 16th-century Seville with a detailed recreation of the city’s port and its inhabitants.

Set sail on an adventure, take the helm of your destiny, and build your commercial empire in Galleons of Fortune!

short_description: In Galleons of Fortune Pioneers, build and manage a thriving trading empire from 16th-century Seville, during the Golden Age of Maritime Trade. Exchange valuable goods, expand your fleet, rival merchants, and the perils of the Atlantic in your quest for riches across the New World.

*languages with full audio support
